description.value:
Arasaka’s combat model, manufactured for extreme precision. Fashion's last gasp along with your enemy's in perfect synchrony.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Foregrip, Smartgun Link, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4), Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, the entire magazine is expended instead. While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged, it is only capable of using Autofire. This weapon’s Tech Rebuild does not need to be charged for it to be able to see and fire through Thin Cover, but does still need to be charged to halve SP. When worn openly, this weapon counts as an installation of Superchrome Coating. While wielded in two hands, this weapon provides its user a +1 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots and Autofire Checks [Excellent Quality + Foregrip].

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Foregrip, Smartgun Link, SMG Cyclic Internals (SMG 4), Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
